E.rule: copy r=-4..4 target spinor Fourier coefficients into identically labelled normalized N-site DFT modes and zero every other construction mode

M.pi_sector: sum of momentum probabilities with abs(q)>=3 pi/4

Phi.mass: m_q maps to mu_q=delta m_q and n_q=sqrt(1-mu_q^2) in the direct edge scatter
Phi.potential: V(x_j,t_q) maps to a charged on-site number phase P_V applied before edge scatter and routing
Phi.causal_probe: a disclosed local phase probe maps to the same construction cells and is used only in algebraic support fixtures before freeze
